name: Ryobi RY40502
blurb: 14″ bar, 3/8″ low profile chain, .043″ gauge, 52 drive links (Oregon R52), from Oregon's saw-chain selection guide.
intro: Oregon's saw-chain selection guide gives Ryobi RY40502 its own line: Oregon R52, a 14″ bar, 52 drive links, .043″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. The guide does not print a file size. Oregon prints RY40502, RY40511 on one line. This is .043″ gauge. The RY3714 line is .050″.

bars.note: Oregon prints R52 for this model line: 14″ bar, 52 drive links, .043″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. No file size is printed.

sources.title: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide: model line printed with saw-chain code, bar length, drive links, gauge and pitch

sources_note: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide (https://apps.oregonproducts.com/pdfs/TSC-Chain-Fit-Guide.pdf), read 9 Nov 2026. The row restates the model line Oregon prints for this saw. Oregon does not print a file size on that line.
